group_list = [[] for _ in range(9)]
popcount_array = [0] * (1 << 9)
prob_array = [0] * 9
aux_array = [0] * 9
dp_map_state = [dict() for _ in range(8)]

for idx_x in range(1 << n_size):
    idx_y = bin(idx_x).count('1')
    popcount_array[idx_x] = len(group_list[idx_y])
    group_list[idx_y].append(idx_x)

dp_map_state[0][1] = 1

for idx_x in range(n_size):
    prob_input = list(map(int, input().split()))
    for idx_y in range(n_size):
        prob_array[idx_y] = prob_input[idx_y] * 570000004 % MOD_CONST

    for state, value in list(dp_map_state[idx_x].items()):
        for k in range(n_size):
            aux_array[k] = 0
        for m in group_list[idx_x]:
            if ((state >> popcount_array[m]) & 1) != 0:
                for j in range(n_size):
                    if ((m >> j) & 1) == 0:
                        aux_array[j] |= (1 << popcount_array[m | (1 << j)])
        for msk in range(1 << n_size):
            val_x = 1
            val_m = 0
            for j in range(n_size):
                if ((msk >> j) & 1) != 0:
                    val_m |= aux_array[j]
                    val_x = val_x * prob_array[j] % MOD_CONST
                else:
                    val_x = val_x * (MOD_CONST + 1 - prob_array[j]) % MOD_CONST
            dp_map_state[idx_x + 1][val_m] = (dp_map_state[idx_x + 1].get(val_m, 0) + value * val_x) % MOD_CONST

print(dp_map_state[n_size].get(1, 0))
